main_text.p: יָאַת Acquievit, Consensit: יָאַתָּה Vide in יָאָה.
יבל Hiphil הוּבִיל Attulit, Detulit, Apportavit, Adduxit, Abduxit, Ded. Red. Chal. Frater. הֵיבִיל Deportaverat, Esr.5.14. Infin. לְהֵיבִלָה Ad deferendum, Esr.7.15. Hophal הוּבַל Adduci, Deduci.
יבל, יובל, אובל m. Fluvius, Aqueductus.
יובל c. Aries: plur. יוֹבְלִים. Item Jubilaeus annus, sic dictus, quod cornu arietis promulgari solebat.
יַבֶּלֶת f. Verruca, Verrucosum: quidam Fluidum, Fluxu laborans.
יָבָם Leviri jus vel officium praestare, Affinitatem contrahere fratris absque liberis defuncti uxorem ducendo.
יִבָּמָת f. Glos, Fratria, uxor fratris.
יָבֵשׁ Aruit, Exaruit, Arefactus, Exsiccatus fuit.
Pihel יִבֵּשׁ Arefacere, Exsiccare. Hiphil הוֹבִישׁ Idem, & quandoq; intransitive.
יָבֵשׁ m. Aridus, Siccus: fem. יְבֵשָׁה.
יִבָּשָׁה, יַבֶּשֶׁת f. Arida, Aridum, Siccum, Ter-
